name: Apimo
positioning: The French transaction system built for agencies that sell across borders — multilingual, multi-currency, open API.
description: Apimo is a real estate CRM and transaction platform used by French and international agencies: listings and contacts, mandates, matching, multilingual publishing to portals in several countries, websites, and a documented open API.
real_estate_use: Agencies on the Côte d'Azur, in the Alps or in border regions sell to buyers who do not read French, through portals in several countries. Apimo handles a listing in multiple languages and currencies from one record, which removes the duplicate-catalogue problem that breaks most domestic tools as soon as a second market appears.
features: Publishing to French and international portals

use_cases.job: Market one property in several languages and currencies without duplicating the record
Publish to French and foreign portals from a single catalogue
